notes.title: Update log about archives and other game optimizations
notes.notes:
At around 12 o'clock in the morning last night, we released the game on STEAM as soon as possible on the occasion of New Year's Eve.

I received some player feedback today. In order to provide players with a better experience, some small details have been optimized and adjusted. An update was made this afternoon. Players in the community and those who have already played can feel it.
 
Then, after the game is updated, some players may find that the archive is missing. In fact, the archive is still there, but we have changed the path. Let me tell you how to restore the archive.
 
Before restoring the archive, please turn on "Hidden Options" in File Explorer


The recovery method is as follows
 
1. Old archive path

C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\Ghost Road Game Studio\Underworld Awakening\Utage\Ghost Road

 
2. New archive path

C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\Ghost Road Game Studio\GhostRoad\SaveProject

 
3. Find the archive file, copy it to the new archive folder, and change the original archive file name "wake up" to "save"

4. Re-enter the game to restore the original save! You're done!



In addition, we have also fixed the problem that the BGM volume becomes smaller when dubbing occurs, and we will adjust the volume of dubbing later.

There are also some other minor issues that do not affect the overall game play and experience.

In terms of UI buttons, players also pointed out that the semi-hidden buttons affect the operation. If they want to make them clearer, they will be adjusted in the future.


If you encounter problems, please join our official community: 873326647

notes.title: Ghost Road: Awakening from the underworld: Demo version has been launched
notes.notes:
About the demo version

In this demo version, we have opened one of the lines for the female lead Su Mei, with a full voice acting gameplay time of about 2 hours and a script of about 33000 words.

Recently, we have also added some illustrations and optimized the UI, and all character dubbing work has been completed.

Plot introduction:
The player plays the role of the Soul Detainer in the underworld. As soon as they return from a business trip in the human world, they are assigned a very tricky task by the Little Yanluo King, which requires them to resolve the rampage of the resentful cage on the Forgotten River. During the process of rescuing the resentful cage Su Mei, the player will travel back to her past through the Rebirth Mirror, attach themselves to other NPCs, experience her tragic experiences, understand her obsession, and help her find ways to escape.

notes.title: Game Development Update Log for Ghost Road
notes.notes:
Hello, dear STEAM players, everyone!

I have been very busy lately and often work overtime until late at night because there are also many players and supporters in some game communities and forums, and I often need to answer their questions in the middle of the night. Alright, without further ado, let me now report the overall progress of the project to everyone.

🎨 fine arts
We have recently added a few illustrations and expressions of the female lead, as well as vertical illustrations, to make the game presentation more diverse.
All scene designs have been completed, and some minor optimizations have been made, such as adding roads and shadows to the details in Buzhou Mountain.

🎤 dubbing
We have completed the re recording and editing of the voices of Youying and Meimei, as well as the additional recording of several characters. Except for Lianyue, all characters and NPC dubbing have been completed. This means that in the game, except for the voiceover and players, all 20 characters have dubbing, with over 5000 lines of dubbing and over 200000 words of script. The entire gameplay time is 6-7 hours, and this scale of dubbing is unparalleled in domestic visual novel games!

🎹 music
The original background music for the game OST, as of yesterday, the last song "Burial of Demons" has been fully produced. I can say that all the music is excellent, and every piece of music is very charming when listened carefully. We would like to thank our arrangement teacher for their efforts!

🌈 Game GUI
Today we have updated another version of the design, which is more exquisite than before, more in line with the theme and characteristics of the game. We have added mouse icons, optimized the game start interface, and added different states of buttons to enhance the game's design sense

💻 program
The program and testing are our main tasks in the future, including updating and replacing many resources, submitting new requirements, providing testing feedback, and optimizing bugs, all of which require the program to complete. Basically, each of our development team members will participate in testing work, propose their own optimization suggestions and requirements, and then the program will make corresponding adjustments based on feedback.

📢 The above is a summary report of all current research and development work.

We will announce the launch date of the demo in the near future, and everyone can also follow it!
I hope everyone can actively participate in the demo version testing when the time comes. 
There will definitely be some shortcomings, and I hope everyone can give us positive feedback without hesitation!
